name: Themed controls help
description: Help mode entries of the Themed controls plugin (help@1): the settings sub-tab, its switches and every themed control family.
author: Brett

entries.title: Themed controls settings
entries.text: Turns the themed controls on or off, one switch per kind of browser element. Off brings back the browser's own control; nothing a form holds is lost.

entries.title: Themed controls
entries.text: The master switch: on swaps every family that is switched on below for its themed control; off makes every control the browser's own again.

entries.title: Bottom sheet on a phone
entries.text: On a phone-sized screen the date, time and colour pickers and the dialogs slide up from the bottom. Off opens them as a pop-over everywhere.

entries.title: Themed checkboxes
entries.text: Tick boxes drawn from the theme instead of the browser. Space ticks one; the colours, size, mark and focus ring are tokens. Off brings the browser box back with the same tick.

entries.title: Themed radio buttons
entries.text: Round choices drawn from the theme. The arrow keys move the choice inside a group, like the browser's. Off brings the browser's back with the same choice.

entries.title: Themed range sliders
entries.text: Sliders with a themed track, fill and thumb. Drag, or use the arrow keys, Page Up / Down, Home and End. A value bubble shows while dragging.

entries.title: Themed number fields
entries.text: Number fields with − and + buttons; hold one to keep counting. Min, max and step are kept; the arrow keys and Page Up / Down step too.

entries.title: Themed date and time pickers
entries.text: A calendar for dates, months and weeks and hour / minute columns for times, instead of the browser picker. Arrow keys move day by day, Page Up / Down by month. On a phone it slides up from the bottom.

entries.title: Themed colour picker
entries.text: Theme colours, recent colours, a saturation and brightness area with a hue strip, and a hex field. Done keeps the colour, Cancel or Escape puts it back.

entries.title: Themed alert, confirm and prompt
entries.text: Messages and questions open as the app's own dialog instead of the browser box. Enter answers OK, Escape cancels; a question that deletes something shows a red button and starts on Cancel.

entries.title: Themed file drop zone
entries.text: Drop files on the zone or tap it to browse. It lists the chosen files with their size, a remove button and an upload bar each, and only takes the file types the field accepts.

entries.title: Themed tooltips
entries.text: The little tip that shows when you rest the pointer on something, drawn from the theme. Keyboard focus shows it at once; on a touch screen press and hold.

entries.title: Themed scrollbars
entries.text: Scrollbars coloured and sized from the theme on a computer. Phones and tablets keep their own thin scrollbars.

entries.title: Tooltips and scrollbars
entries.text: How long the pointer rests before a tip shows, how long it stays, how long to press on a touch screen, and how wide the scrollbars are. They are theme tokens, so a theme can set them too; "Back to the theme's values" undoes your changes.

entries.title: What each switch replaces
entries.text: Which browser element each switch replaces and whether it is themed on this page now. Add data-axf-native to an element or a form to keep it the browser's own.

entries.title: Tooltip delay
entries.text: How long the pointer rests on something before its tip shows, in milliseconds.

entries.title: Scrollbar width
entries.text: How wide the themed scrollbars are on a computer, in pixels.

entries.title: Date and time picker
entries.text: The calendar or time columns that open from a date or time field. Pick a day with the arrow keys and Enter, or tap it.

entries.title: Colour picker
entries.text: Opens from a colour field: tap a swatch or drag in the colour area, then Done.

entries.title: Themed dialog
entries.text: A message or a question from the page. OK answers yes, Cancel answers no; type into the field when it asks for text.

steps.say: These switches swap the controls your browser draws, like checkboxes, date pickers and pop-up messages, for ones drawn from your theme.
Turn one kind off here if you prefer the browser's own. Nothing you typed into a form is lost.
Tooltips and scrollbars have their own timing and size here.
